mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( id, customer_email, amount, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{order.id,typeHandler=com.example.orderservice.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{order.customerEmail}, #{order.amount}, #{order.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{order.createdAt} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( id, order_id, product_code, quantity, unit_price ) VALUES ( #{item.id,typeHandler=com.example.orderservice.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{item.orderId,typeHandler=com.example.orderservice.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{item.productCode}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_email, amount, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.example.orderservice.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.customer_email, o.amount, o.status, o.created_at,
i.id AS item_id, i.order_id, i.product_code, i.quantity, i.unit_price FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.example.orderservice.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}
